about.heading: INITIALIZING_PROFILE...
about.bio: I move fast in new environments and I don't wait for permission to start — years of picking things up on the fly turned into a habit of teaching myself whatever a project needs, from Sketchware and HTML back in secondary school to Android Studio and design tools since. I design in Figma, Inkscape, Adobe XD, Photoshop, and CorelDraw, and I build what I design rather than hand it off and hope. Right now that shows up at McLuke — designing ads, running large-format and DTF printing, and handling the machines that make it real. I'm still finishing things up on paper too (graduating Uncommon this December, working through BYU Pathway's PC103 before picking a degree), but most of what I know came from doing, not sitting in a classroom.

skills.label: Self-taught Development — Sketchware, HTML, Android Studio

origin.heading: WHERE_I_START_FROM
origin.story: Born in Harare, raised in motion — Hurungwe, then Harare, then back again — until I finished my final year of school in the city I now call home. Second of four. Part of that time I spent at my grandmother's, where being the one who got disciplined most taught me manners early. My father was around until 2014; what I took from that came later, mostly lessons in what not to be. Moving that much teaches you to read a new environment fast and get comfortable being the newest person in the room. That instinct never really left — it's how I approach a new codebase, brand, or problem.

family.label: Mother
family.quote: A natural hustler who never plays with her money — taught me that figuring out how to make things easier for the people you love is worth the work.

family.label: Younger Brother
family.quote: A footballer who doesn't let outside noise change his game — taught me to brush off criticism that isn't actually trying to help.

family.label: Me
family.quote: All of it — the good and the bad — is what makes Nyasha Gabriel.

family.label: Younger Brother
family.quote: Still figuring out his own path, but stands his ground the same way — you don't let non-constructive critics write your identity for you.

family.label: Older Sister
family.quote: More of a junior parent than a sibling — most of my manners, I picked up from her.
